summary: @ReviewTalentFS was originally designed as a teacher observation feedback system, but its really a two level rubric and form builder that spits out scales in json so I can run analysis in R or SPSS like interclass correlations, I do stats bespoke for clients

body_html: @ReviewTalentFS was originally designed as a teacher observation feedback system, but its really a two level rubric and form builder that spits out scales in json so I can run analysis in R or SPSS like interclass correlations, I do stats bespoke for clients
